entities.name: Cliffside Market
entities.description: A sprawling noisy market on the edge of the upside-down Mount Mercadia in Mercadia City.

entities.name: Mercadia City
entities.description: City on Mercadia containing the market.

entities.name: Weatherlight crew
entities.description: The crew brought by the Magistrate's soldiers to the market.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member who engineers an escape.

entities.name: Atalla
entities.description: A boy used by Gerrard as co-conspirator.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Fights the cateran enforcer alongside Gerrard.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: Goblin crew member whose presence makes the cateran submit.

entities.name: Cateran enforcer
entities.description: A horror with superior combat skills that thinks Squee a Kyren.

events.summary: Gerrard uses Atalla to steal a wineskin and provoke a brawl with the guards, hoping to escape.
A cateran enforcer almost wins the battle until it notices Squee.
events.quote: the battle was almost lost until the horror noticed that Squee was part of the crew

events.summary: The cateran submits to Squee and lets the crew escape into Mercadia City.
events.quote: the cateran allowed the crew to escape into Mercadia City

relations.note: Submitted to the goblin's will, thinking him a Kyren.
relations.quote: Quickly submitting to the goblin 's will
